Ethical platforms to use instead of Etsy. Here are 7 ethical alternatives people are switching to. Artisans Cooperative. Owned by its makers and shoppers, one vote per member, with the community verifying shops are handmade. Folksy. It bans resellers and mass-produced imports, and makers get paid directly. Handfair. One owner, no investors, makers keep 100% of the item price, and it blocks AI from training on their work. Mayhem Marketplace. It charges a flat subscription instead of taking a cut of every sale, and it bans dropshipping and products made mainly by AI. Marmalade. A small team that checks the handmade shops it promotes. No AI, no dropshipping. Big Cartel. Independent since 2005, no commission, and a free plan. Wolf & Badger. A certified B Corp marketplace where every brand is owned by its designer. Starting December 16, Etsy and its partners can use sellers' photos and descriptions to train AI. Sellers can't just turn it off in their settings. Artists are already pulling their shops. Over the years, Etsy started allowing factory-made goods, went public, dropped its B Corp certification, and now answers to shareholders before its users. Buyers say the site is filled with junk. Etsy is rated a D on the Conscious Spend app, where we are on a mission to show consumers how ethical almost any company is so people can find ethical alternatives to evil corporations. You can also use the app to see who owns what you buy, better alternatives, and the ethics score, and join over 125k people using it to spend for a better world.

Etsy has decided to make a new policy that would make it so that they could take any listing image up on their page (starting on Dec. 16th) and take it to train AI. I think it’s absolutely ridiculous that Etsy is doing this, especially since SO many artists use their site to host their shop. Ever since I heard the news, I knew I had to make the unfortunate decision to close my shop (which sucks because I haven’t even had it open for a year yet!). If anyone has any suggestions for where to host my shop, I would super appreciate it! And if you could help support me and my shop that would be super appreciated as well! I will be having a sale from Nov. 8th-Dec. 15th (and on Dec. 15th I will be closing my shop for good).
